# AI Coding Blue Books Series (book.pmer.cn)

> Independent bilingual (Chinese & English) engineering handbooks for AI coding agents by Hunk Wu (aipmer / pmer.cn). Verified November 26, 2026. All 4 books live: OpenAI Codex (v1.5.0), Claude Code (v1.0.0), Google Antigravity / Gemini 4 (v1.0.0), and Kimi Code / K3.1 Pro (v1.0.0).

## Core Hubs & Tools

- [Chinese Series Portal (首页)](https://book.pmer.cn/): Overview of all four Blue Books (Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi).
- [English Series Portal](https://book.pmer.cn/en/): English overview of the four-book series.
- [2026 Four-Agent Comparison Matrix (中文)](https://book.pmer.cn/compare): Side-by-side comparison of GPT-6.2 Codex, Claude 5.5 Claude Code, Gemini 4 Antigravity, and Kimi K3.1 Pro pricing, context windows, primitives, and FAQs.
- [2026 Four-Agent Comparison Matrix (English)](https://book.pmer.cn/en/compare): English side-by-side comparison of all four AI coding agents.
- [Multi-Agent Rules Generator (中文)](https://book.pmer.cn/generator): Interactive generator exporting AGENTS.md (Codex), CLAUDE.md + Hooks (Claude Code), .agents/rules (Gemini Antigravity), and config.toml (Kimi Code).
- [Multi-Agent Rules Generator (English)](https://book.pmer.cn/en/generator): English interactive multi-agent rules generator.
